title: Draw and select a closed path to inspect its size badge
steps: Select the Path tool in the empty file.
Click three points on the canvas, then click the first point to close the path.
Press Escape to leave path editing and inspect the selected path.

video_guide.summary: Follow the triangle from drawing to selection. The selection's size badge displays x instead of the path dimensions.

chapters.note: Two connected edges are drawn with the path tool.
The third edge closes the triangular path.

chapters.label: Select the closed path and inspect its size

chapters.note: The selected triangle has a bounding box, but the badge below it reads x.
The badge still reads x while the properties panel shows width 260 and height 210.
